description: tests/bettertls.rs is a characterization test asserting observed behavior matches baseline-pkix-path.json, not a pass/fail conformance test. A contributor will eventually suggest "these fixtures should all return built_and_valid; flip the test to assert that". This is wrong: 23 of 25 fixtures already validate end-to-end (tc41 is a corpus-FAILURE correctly rejected; tc60 is a documented divergence resolved at the build_first_valid_path layer, not at build_path). The snapshot pattern means: a regression in build_path's DFS ordering immediately surfaces as a baseline diff, not as a silent behavior change. The discover-mode (BETTERTLS_BASELINE_DISCOVER=1) plus the readme guidance to review the diff before regenerating is the right discipline. Mirrors the pkix-difftest/baseline-*.json pattern that already exists in the workspace.
title: bettertls characterization test as a snapshot (not pass/fail) is the right pattern
